# discord_role (Data Source)

Looks up a server role by ID or name, e.g. to reference roles created outside Terraform or by integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Roles created by integrations or by hand can be referenced by name.
data "discord_role" "server_booster" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "Server Booster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the role. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Name of the role. The lookup fails if no role or more than one has this name.

### Read-Only

- `color` (Number) Primary RGB color.
- `hoist` (Boolean) Whether members are displayed separately.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the role is managed by an integration.
- `mentionable` (Boolean) Whether the role can be mentioned by anyone.
- `permissions` (String) Permission bitfield as a decimal string.
- `position` (Number) Role position.
